speaker: Doctor
text: I see you're experiencing fatigue, weight gain, and cold intolerance. To better understand what might be going on, have you noticed any changes in your heart rate, such as feeling your heart beat slowly or irregularly?

speaker: Patient
text: I haven't really noticed my heart beating slowly or irregularly, but I do agree that feeling unusually tired and gaining weight without changing my habits are the main issues I've been facing lately. I also tend to feel much colder than others in the room, and even my own family has mentioned that my voice sounds a bit hoarse. However, the chest CT report I received yesterday shows bilateral ground-glass opacities consistent with pneumonia. You do not need to order new imaging. Use this result.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Hypothyroidism (likely Hashimoto's thyroiditis) with incidental or secondary findings on the chest CT unrelated to the primary endocrine symptoms. The combination of fatigue, weight gain, cold intolerance, and hoarseness strongly points to thyroid dysfunction despite the unrelated pneumonia findings.
